segments.text: Now let's know about the 10 questions of Fire Alarm.
segments.zh: 现在我们来看 10 道火灾报警题。

segments.text: The first question is, Protective premises for Alarm system are Option A, Most basic, Option B, Design to be initiated manually, Option C, A and B option both and Option D use at banks only.
segments.zh: 第一题是：受保护场所的报警系统是：选项 A，最基本的；选项 B，设计为手动启动的；选项 C，A 和 B 两项都是；选项 D，仅用于银行。

segments.text: Then the next question is, Automatic Alarm system.
segments.zh: 下一题是：自动报警系统。

segments.text: Option A is, Dedicated wire pairs through signal, Leased telephone lines through fiber optic cable or wireless communication through signal.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是，通过专用线对传输信号、通过光纤电缆租用电话线路，或通过无线通信传输信号。

segments.text: Option B is, High degree false alarm compared to other system.
segments.zh: 选项 B 是，与其他系统相比误报率高。

segments.text: Option C is, It can be activated manually.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是，它可以手动启动。

segments.text: Option D is, B and C option.
segments.zh: 选项 D 是，B 和 C 两项。

segments.text: Then the next question is, Automatic Alarm initiating devices.
segments.zh: 下一题是：自动报警触发装置，

segments.text: What is included in its basic types?
segments.zh: 它的基本类型包括哪些？

segments.text: Option A is, Heat Detector, Option B is, Rate of Rise Heat Detector, Option C is, Smoke Detector and Option D is all these.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是感温探测器，选项 B 是差温感温探测器，选项 C 是感烟探测器，选项 D 是以上全部。

segments.text: Then the next question is, What are the two basic types of Smoke Detector?
segments.zh: 下一题是：感烟探测器的两种基本类型是什么？

segments.text: Option A is, Ionization and Rate of Rise, Option B is, Ionization and Photoelectric, Option C is, Photoelectric and Rate of Rise and Option D is, Rate of Rise and Flame.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是离子式和差温式，选项 B 是离子式和光电式，选项 C 是光电式和差温式，选项 D 是差温式和火焰式。

segments.text: Then the next question is, What are Photoelectric Smoke Detector?
segments.zh: 下一题是：光电式感烟探测器有什么特点？

segments.text: Option A is, It is more sensitive in Smoldering Fires. Option B is, It is less sensitive in Smoldering Fires.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是，它对阴燃火更灵敏。选项 B 是，它对阴燃火不太灵敏。

segments.text: Option C is, It has the same reaction in Smoldering Fires. Option D is, It is more responsive in Flaming Fires.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是，它对阴燃火的反应相同。选项 D 是，它对明火响应更快。

segments.text: Then the next question is, What are the two basic types of Smoke Detector?
segments.zh: 下一题是：感烟探测器的两种基本类型是什么？

segments.text: Option A is, It is more sensitive in Smoldering Fires. Option B is, It has the same reaction in Smoldering Fires as in Photoelectric Detector.
segments.zh: 选项 A 是，它对阴燃火更灵敏。选项 B 是，它对阴燃火的反应与光电式探测器相同。

segments.text: Option C is, It is more responsive in Flaming Fires. Option D is, It has the same reaction in Flaming Fires as in Photoelectric Detector.
segments.zh: 选项 C 是，它对明火响应更快。选项 D 是，它对明火的反应与光电式探测器相同。
